description: Per-CWE inputs for generated security regression tests. 'vulnerable' is a regex that must not match the file unless 'mitigation' (regex) also matches. 'payloads' feed the behavioural test skeleton.

CWE-89.label: SQL injection
payloads: ' UNION SELECT null, username, password FROM users--
CWE-89.behaviour: Call the query method with each payload against a test database and assert that no extra rows are returned and no SQL error leaks.
CWE-89.assertion: assertTrue(result.isEmpty(), "injection payload must not match any row");

CWE-22.label: path traversal
CWE-22.behaviour: Call the file-handling method with each payload and assert it rejects the input instead of reading outside the base directory.

CWE-78.label: OS command injection
CWE-78.behaviour: Call the method that runs the command with each payload and assert the input is rejected by allow-list validation.

CWE-798.label: hard-coded credential
CWE-798.behaviour: Assert that the credential is read from configuration (e.g. System.getenv) and that the application fails fast when it is missing.

CWE-321.label: hard-coded cryptographic key
CWE-321.behaviour: Assert that the signing/encryption key is loaded from a key store or environment secret and differs between environments.

CWE-259.label: hard-coded password
CWE-259.behaviour: Assert that the password is read from configuration.

CWE-327.label: broken cryptographic algorithm
CWE-327.behaviour: Encrypt the same plaintext twice and assert the ciphertexts differ (random IV) and that the transformation is AES/GCM/NoPadding.

CWE-328.label: weak hash
CWE-328.behaviour: Hash a password and assert the stored value uses a slow salted algorithm (for example starts with $2a$ for bcrypt).

CWE-502.label: unsafe deserialization
CWE-502.behaviour: Feed a serialized object of an unexpected class (e.g. a ysoserial gadget, base64 above is a harmless HashMap) and assert it is rejected with InvalidClassException.
